sentences: Pepto-Bismol and peptaibols are not the same, although their names sound somewhat similar
Pepto-Bismol is an over-the-counter medication commonly used to treat minor digestive system ailments like diarrhea, nausea, heartburn, indigestion, and upset stomach
It was originally sold as a remedy for infant diarrhea by Norwich Pharmaceutical Company under the name Bismosal and later changed to Pepto-Bismol in 1919
On the other hand, peptaibols are a class of biologically active peptides produced by certain fungi, particularly from the genus Trichoderma
These peptides contain unusual amino acids, including α-aminoisobutyric acid (Aib), and have antibiotic and antifungal properties
Peptaibols are part of a larger group of peptides known as peptaibiotics, which are known for their ability to form helical structures and disrupt cell membranes, leading to cell death
